rules.accepted_credit_types: Contact hour = 60 minutes. At least 18 hours Category 1: courses of 3+ hours approved by the Board/its designee, FSBPT, another PT licensing agency or APTA and its components; APTA-produced courses under 3 hours; college credit courses (12 h per semester credit); presenting approved courses; publications (15 h, max 2); posters/platforms (10 h, max 2); part-time teaching (max 20); ABPTS certification (28 h); residency/fellowship (max 28); 1,000 h of practice (5 h); Board/APTA/FSBPT service; APTA membership (1 h/year, max 2); HRRI Healthy Practice Resource modules (max 6). Category 2 (max 10 hours): literature reading, unapproved courses (max 3 per course), clinical instructor (1 h per 16 h), in-service/study group (max 2), community service (max 2), APTA KY mentorship (max 4), CPR/bloodborne pathogens (max 2).
rules.audit_note: Keep verifiable documentation at least 2 years after the end of the biennium; provide evidence within 30 days of a written Board request. False certification is grounds for discipline. Hardship extension (form by April 30 of the odd year) or non-hardship extension (form by March 31, $250 fee, proof by July 1).

topics.who: Board-provided open-book Jurisprudence Examination (tutorial on KRS Chapter 327 and 201 KAR Chapter 22) each biennium; counts as 2 of the 30 hours

rules.notes: Credentials renew by March 31 of each odd-numbered year; CE must be completed during the preceding renewal period. Courses repeated more than once in the same biennium earn no credit. The Board's own website returned 403 at check time; numbers taken from the regulation.
rules.rule_quote: (a) For a physical therapist, the board shall require thirty (30) contact hours as a condition of licensure renewal.
